title: Top N devices by memory
hints: sorted(devices, key=...) returns a new list and leaves the input alone; slice the result with [:n].
A key that returns a tuple sorts by the first element and breaks ties with the second: (memory, hostname).
Memory must go down while hostname goes up: negate the memory in the key, (-mem, hostname), instead of using reverse=True which would flip both.
d.get("memory_gb") or 0 turns both a missing key and None into 0.
